::: {.why}
The abandonment criteria are the part of a research document that separates a report from an advertisement, and writing them after the result is worth less than writing them before, so today at least writes them explicitly.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State three specific conditions under which you would have abandoned the pairs strategy, and whether each was met.
- Say which of your earlier numbers in this phase you now believe was wrong.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>55 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Write the abandonment section of reports/milestone-03-pairs.md: three conditions with thresholds attached, each checked against what actually happened. Include the cost level at which the strategy dies and where your actual costs sit relative to it.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Assemble the phase-3 self-check questions and answer all seven out loud, timed. Anything that takes more than two minutes is a compression problem rather than a knowledge problem, and marking which is which is the point of doing it now rather than in July.
:::
:::
